title: TenancyServiceUpdatedPayload
description: Payload of `tenancy.service.updated` version 1: a partner's service of a kind was created or replaced with `PUT /v1/partners/{partner_id}/services/{kind}`. The envelope's `partner_id` is the partner. The configuration is not part of the payload; read it with `GET /v1/partners/{partner_id}/services`. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

partner_id.description: The partner that runs the service, the same value as the envelope's `partner_id`.

kind.description: The kind of service that was put.

status.description: The status of the service after the put.
